tools.name: is_business_day_free
tools.description: FREE: check whether a date between today and 90 days ahead (JST) is a business day in Japan. Official Cabinet Office holiday data, supports bank calendar (Dec 31 - Jan 3). For other dates, business-day arithmetic or holiday lists use the paid tools.

tools.name: is_business_day
tools.description: Check whether a date is a business day in Japan (official Cabinet Office holiday data). Returns holiday name (JA/EN) and next/previous business day. Price: $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: Add or subtract N Japanese business days from a date (settlement T+N, delivery ETA). Price: $0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: list_holidays
tools.description: List Japanese national holidays for a year with JA/EN names. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: payment_due_date
tools.description: Japanese payment terms (shimebi/shiharaibi) calculator, e.g. month-end close paid end of next month; shifts to the previous/next business day on weekends/holidays. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: bank_value_date
tools.description: When will a Japanese bank transfer be credited? Returns the value date under standard processing (same day before the cutoff, default 15:00 JST, on a bank business day; otherwise next bank business day). Price: $0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: jpx_trading_day
tools.description: Is the Tokyo Stock Exchange (JPX) open on a date? Next/previous trading day, first/last trading day of the year. Price: $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: jpx_record_date
tools.description: Japanese stocks: last cum-rights trading day and ex-rights date for a dividend/benefit record date (T+2 settlement, holiday-aware). Price: $0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: jpx_sq_date
tools.description: Nikkei 225 futures/options SQ day and last trading day for a contract month (2nd Friday, moved earlier on holidays). Price: $0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: japanese_koyomi
tools.description: Japanese traditional calendar for a date: rokuyo (taian/butsumetsu lucky days), Reiwa era date, lunisolar date, 24 solar terms. Price: $0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: find_lucky_days_japan
tools.description: Find auspicious Japanese dates: days in a range matching rokuyo (e.g. taian) and optional weekdays (e.g. sat,sun) for weddings, moving, contracts. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402.
